features: 12W Ultra Loud Portable Bluetooth Speaker - Dynamic Thunder Bass That Fills Any Room Powered by a large 66mm driver and 12W output, the TRIGGR Roar 12 delivers deep, dynamic thunder bass that punches well above its price. Whether it's a house party, hostel room, balcony session, or outdoor gathering - every beat hits hard and loud without distortion.

8 Hours Rechargeable Playtime - From Home to Outdoors, the Music Never Stops Built-in rechargeable battery delivers up to 8 hours of continuous wireless music - enough for a full day at home, a picnic, road trip, or an outdoor party. Fast Type-C charging tops it back up quickly, so you're never stuck waiting with a dead speaker.

5 Ways to Play -Bluetooth v5.3, FM Radio, USB-A, USB-C & SD Card Support Connect wirelessly via Bluetooth v5.3 for stable streaming . No internet? Plug in a USB drive (USB-A), use a USB-C cable, or insert a microSD card to play downloaded music directly on this portable wireless speaker. FM Radio makes it a 5-in-1 audio companion for home and outdoor use.

Double the Sound, Double the Party with TWS Wireless Stereo Pairing TWS (True Wireless Stereo) lets you pair two speakers simultaneously creating full wireless stereo sound with wider coverage for home parties, terrace gatherings, or any outdoor space. No cables, no apps, instant sync for a bigger, louder party experience.

More Than a Speaker - Loud HandsFree Calling for Home, Office & Outdoors The built-in MEMS microphone lets you answer calls directly from this portable Bluetooth speaker with crystal-clear voice quality , no need to reach for your phone. A perfect daily-use companion for work-from-home setups, kitchens, outdoor workspaces, and on-the-go conversations.

Premium Rubber Finish, 4 Bold Colors — the Perfect Gift for Music Lovers The soft-touch rubber finish is scratch-resistant and gives the Roar 12 a premium, grip-friendly feel for both home décor and outdoor carry. Available in Red Eclipse, Rustic Dust, Onyx Blue, and Midnight Sun — a stylish portable Bluetooth speaker that makes a great birthday, festival, or occasion gift for music lovers of any age.
